title: Distributed Optimization with Coupled Constraints over Time-Varying Digraph
summary: In this paper, we develop a distributed algorithm for solving a class of distributed convex optimization problems where the local objective functions can be a general nonsmooth function, and all equalities and inequalities are network-wide coupled. This type of problem arises from many areas, such as economic dispatch, network utility maximization, and demand response.
